property_summary: After a successful call to updateWinnersPerPeriod(x), the public getter winnersPerPeriod() must return exactly x for every caller with admin access and every admissible x; the mutant returns x+1, violating the rule for any x.
change_summary: Replace the assignment so winnersPerPeriod is set to newWinnersPerPeriodAmount + 1 instead of the given amount.
